selfHelpStops.condition: The prosecutor or a victim files an objection.
Whether the offence is on the § 12-25-32 violent offense list is unclear.
Whether the offence is a crime of moral turpitude under § 17-3-30.1 is unclear.
Whether the offence is a serious traffic offense under Title 32 is unclear.
Whether an Act 2015-185 reclassification applies is unclear.
Whether all court-ordered amounts including interest are satisfied is unclear.
The participant is choosing which record to spend one of the two capped expungements on.
Immigration, licensing or firearm consequences are in play.

requiredParticipantInputQuestions.question: On what date were you convicted? Three years must have passed.
Was this a youthful offender adjudication rather than a conviction?
Have you completed all probation or parole requirements, including paying all fines, costs, restitution and other court-ordered amounts?
Is the offence on the § 12-25-32 violent offense list?
Is the offence a sex offense under § 15-20A-5?
Is the offence a crime of moral turpitude under § 17-3-30.1?
Is the offence a serious traffic offense under Article 9 of Chapter 5A of Title 32? DUI sits there.
At the time of the offence, were you operating a commercial motor vehicle or holding a CDL or CLP?
Was the crime a felony at conviction but reclassified as a misdemeanor under Act 2015-185?
requiredParticipantInputQuestions.conditionDescription: Asked on the moral-turpitude branch, where the reclassification carve-out applies.

requiredParticipantInputQuestions.question: Have you already had two expungements granted under the capped routes?

supportingDocuments.name: Certified local record — conviction and evidence of completion
supportingDocuments.obtainedFrom: The clerk of the court where the charges were filed, or the supervising agency
supportingDocuments.howToObtain: Ask the clerk or supervising agency for certified evidence that all probation or parole requirements and court-ordered amounts are satisfied.

supportingDocuments.name: Certified ALEA criminal record
supportingDocuments.howToObtain: Request a certified criminal record from ALEA.

destination.name: Criminal division of the circuit court, county where the charges were filed
destination.detail: Discretionary on the § 15-27-5(b) factors, plus the court's discretion over volume.

manualCompletionItems: The petitioner signs their own petition.
